corpus.scope_warning: PILOT CORPUS — 5 fatigued brands of 81 in scope. 'unclaimed' means absent from THIS sample, not proven absent from the category. Verify against the full 81 before putting an unclaimed angle in front of a client.
corpus.absence_is_measured_on: Hook position only — the ad's opening line, which is what was captured in full. Body copy was stored truncated, so NO claim is made about whether an angle appears deeper in an ad, and the probes must not be read as evidence about it. Observed directly while collecting: DRMTLGY runs '🩺 Dermatologist Recommended' as a trust bullet. So dermatologist_as_ally exists in the category as reassurance and is still unclaimed as an opening argument — which is the unit being sold, and a sharper finding than simple absence.

unclaimed_angles.description: Water quality — hard water and chlorine as the upstream cause. Adjacent categories run this hard; no skincare brand in the corpus touches it.

evidence: All results are cleaning and appliance products -- dishwasher powder, washing machine tablets, hard-water spot remover. No skincare advertiser found.
Note eskiin works this angle hard, but it is a filtered showerhead and was excluded from this corpus as beauty_device.

demoted_candidates.description: GLP-1 / weight-loss facial volume loss ('Ozempic face') — rapid loss deflates the midface and is the single loudest skin conversation of the moment.

evidence: Worked hard, but by INGESTIBLES, not topical skincare: Ownist Global (collagen shot), Lemon & Co. (collagen elixir, live since 30 Oct 2025), Heart & Soil (GLP-1 stack).
No topical facial skincare advertiser found running it. Still open for a topical brand -- but the audience has already been taught the frame by supplement ads, so it is not virgin territory.

demoted_candidates.description: Perimenopause / menopause skin — estrogen decline changes barrier, collagen and oil within months. The corpus sells to 40+ women without ever naming the transition they are in.

evidence: Maelove — topical facial skincare, runs it in hook position: 'Perimenopause changed my skin before I even realized what was happening... When estrogen drops, collagen production slows'. Live since 22 Jul 2026. Maelove is in our own candidates.json; our 12-brand sample simply did not include it.
Olay — #perimenopause #midlifewomen creator ad. Olay is in targets.csv.
Michael Todd Beauty — 7 ads on 'After 40, estrogen shifts change your skin'.

demoted_candidates.description: Pregnancy- and nursing-safe actives — a hard constraint that forces a routine rebuild and makes switching brand-agnostic.

evidence: Primally Pure Skincare — topical, creator ad, pregnancy-safe switch as the hook.
Secret Saviours — topical pregnancy skincare system.
Tiny field (6 ads total vs ~33,000 mentioning menopause), so claimed but barely contested -- arguably the most attractive of the demoted angles.
